messages.subject: Non-zero means in multivariate Gaussian density
messages.subject_clean: Non-zero means in multivariate Gaussian density
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone!

Does anyone know how to specify non-zero means to compute a multivariate Gaussian density with TMB?
The two TMB functions that I found for this are listed here <https://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/namespacedensity.html> : MVNORM_t <https://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/classdensity_1_1MVNORM__t.html> (user-provided covariance matrix) and UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t <https://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/classdensity_1_1UNSTRUCTURED__CORR__t.html> (unstructured correlation matrix) but they both assume zero means

As a last resort, I can write a function to do this, but ideally someone has already done it :)

Many thanks!
